events.symptom: Every round repeated the full dashboard and score even when the user already understood the framework.
events.evidence_summary: Sanitized maintainer replay: user repeatedly redirected the interaction toward substantive discussion.
events.root_cause_candidate: Fixed chat template was treated as mandatory instead of adaptive.
events.lesson: Default to lightweight chat; show the full dashboard only when state changes materially or the user asks.
events.do_not_repeat: Do not render full four-quadrant dashboard every round by default.

events.symptom: Grill sometimes became a multiple-choice preference question instead of attacking a decisive blind spot.
events.evidence_summary: Sanitized maintainer feedback requested stronger counterexamples, failure analysis and route tradeoffs.
events.root_cause_candidate: Question-generation rule optimized format completion rather than decision value.
events.lesson: Rank questions by decision impact and use counterexamples for advanced users.
events.do_not_repeat: Do not ask a low-impact preference question when a higher-impact evaluator or failure-mode question exists.

events.symptom: Search/verify/select/remember/evolve framing improved the usefulness of long research discussions.
events.evidence_summary: Sanitized maintainer feedback explicitly requested this loop to become part of the Skill.
events.lesson: Preserve the evolutionary loop and make failures update future search policy.
events.do_not_repeat: Do not treat failed routes as disposable chat history.

candidate_mutations.expected_benefit: Less repetitive UI, higher-value Grill, and reusable experience memory.
regression_risks: May hide too much state for users who prefer dashboards.
Meta-review could overfit to one session.
